In the United States, employees generally have the right to discuss their wages and salaries with their coworkers. This is protected under the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA), which safeguards employees' rights to engage in "concerted activities" for the purpose of collective bargaining or other mutual aid or protection. Discussing salary can be a part of these activities, helping employees identify wage disparities or discrimination. Therefore, it is legal to discuss your salary with your coworkers.

Answer: C
